newsitem.title: USA: AFL-CIO chief lauds Boeing-McDonnell agreement.
newsitem.headline: AFL-CIO chief lauds Boeing-McDonnell agreement.

text.p: AFL-CIO President John Sweeney on Monday lauded the merger agreement between Boeing Co. and McDonnell Douglas Corp., saying it would help both companies and increase jobs.

Before the merger was announced, Sweeney said both companies briefed George Kourpias, president of the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers, which represents thousands of workers at both companies.

"Speaking on behalf of George Kourpias and the machinists, the machinists feel that this will increase our competitiveness in the world market and will increase jobs," Sweeney said after a meeting of the 78-union federation's Executive Council, of which Kourpias is a member.
Sweeney said union leaders would meet with executives of both companies next month to discuss the merger further.
"I'm sure that the employees of both companies are damn proud of the fact that they are members of the machinists union," he said.
"I think that the statements in the press from both companies about no layoffs are an indication of the strong union that represents those workers," he added.
